examples.turoyo: Ono komexeno u taʕno du ḥmoro . (İlyas p.c)
examples.translation: I am tightening/binding/fixing/fitting the donkey load.
examples.raw:
Ono komexeno u taʕno du ḥmoro . (İlyas p.c)  
I am tightening/binding/fixing/fitting the donkey load.

examples.turoyo: maḥtíwayna ʕoqǝlyoṯe daḥ=ḥmore w kefe w medone mʕalqíwayna appe d-mәmxәn (for them to be stretched) d-mәmxәn hŭl d-nәšfi әmmíwayna-watre.
examples.translation: we hanged up (these things) on them (the former intestines) for them to be stretched,  for them to be stretched till they get dry, we call them watre.
examples.raw: maḥtíwayna ʕoqǝlyoṯe daḥ=ḥmore w kefe w medone mʕalqíwayna appe d-mәmxәn (for them to be stretched) d-mәmxәn hŭl d-nәšfi әmmíwayna-watre. we hanged up (these things) on them (the former intestines) for them to be stretched,  for them to be stretched till they get dry, we call them watre. 006_NE_GALA;17
